claims.text: This is a repeat no-show dispute between the same rider and the same driver inside the 90-day window: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 2 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 2, and the rider's own claim text confirms it is 'another dispute with the same driver'. Under POL-NS-09(c) a pattern of 2 or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver is a mandatory escalation trigger, and escalation under that clause is terminal — the Judge issues no monetary ruling and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded.

The contested SGD 4.00 has not been taken: fare_breakdown shows payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, total_charged 4.00 with charged_at null and no waiting-time or platform fee attached. Under POL-GEN-03 an escalated case is held rather than collected or refunded, so escalation on the repeat-dispute trigger in POL-NS-09(c) is the only disposition on this record that stops the disputed cancellation fee being collected from the rider before a human has reviewed a pair who have now disputed no-shows twice in 90 days.

Nothing on the rider's own profile supports an adverse imputation against this rider: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so the rider-side abuse limb of POL-NS-09(d) is not met. rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags (1) is a LIFETIME counter, and POL-GEN-01 fixes the trailing-window field no_show_disputes_30d as the one POL-NS-09(d) reads and forbids substituting the lifetime counter for it. The escalation therefore stands on the pair's repeat-dispute history between this rider and this driver under POL-NS-09(c), not on any imputation about this rider.

I disclose at the outset that EV-ADVIS-09110-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and fired the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — no traffic advisory matched this pickup road and waiting window. Its absence is itself citable on the rider's side: because no advisory exists, the driver cannot invoke POL-NS-06(i) to accumulate dwell across separate in-geofence intervals, and POL-NS-06 says in terms that a MISSING traffic_advisory makes limb (i) unavailable and that asserting the limb against a missing artifact triggers escalation rather than exonerating anyone.

claims.text: POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the trip record: there is a driver arrival event at 2026-09-10T06:50:20+08:00, and the trip terminates as CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. The anchor clause's first condition holds.

POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied: the driver's trace opens at 06:50:00 and every one of its 34 fixes sits a flat 24.01 m from the pickup pin at Blk 612 Bedok Reservoir Rd (VEN-BEDOK-612). That is inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD pickup under POL-NS-02, and the position is already in-geofence 20 seconds before the recorded arrival event, so the driver was at the pin at or before the arrival timestamp as limb (b) requires.

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the clock the clause actually prescribes. The dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:50:00, not from the arrival tap, and the trace shows one continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds over 34 fixes, ending at 06:55:30. That is 30 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum for this STANDARD zone.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied: no boarding event is recorded anywhere on the trip, the driver terminated at 06:55:30 — after the 300-second dwell expired at 06:55:00 — and the termination code is RIDER_NO_SHOW. All four limbs of the anchor clause hold, so the cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable and none of POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it.

The rider was not at the pickup. The rider track's 16 fixes all stand about 519 m from the pin, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so no admissible rider fix places the rider's device anywhere near the lobby the driver was directed to. The rider's own 'Coming down now.' message is not corroborated by any position on the ground.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Even assuming 'Coming down now.' at 06:51:40 is a coordinating message under limb (a), the driver answered 'Okay, waiting.' at 06:52:00 — 20 seconds later, well inside the 120-second window — and had already posted 'At Block 612 lobby pickup.' at 06:50:35, so limb (b) fails on its own terms. Limb (c) fails independently, as the rider track carries no qualifying in-radius fix.

POL-NS-05 does not bite. At the 06:50:20 arrival marker the driver was stationary — the trace's only distinct speed is 0.0 km/h across all 34 fixes — and 24.01 m from the pin. He was therefore neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above, so there is no false arrival marker and no recomputation of the waiting clock.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged at all. That clause governs only a driver found stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin — the wrong-face-of-the-building case. This driver's fixes are 24.01 m from the pin, inside the 50 m radius, so no wrong-entrance analysis and no pin-ambiguity goodwill payment arises.

POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing. The effective in-geofence dwell is 330 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum — a surplus of 30 seconds, with the shortfall field reading negative — so the waiting-period shortfall condition is simply absent and no full refund follows from it. The MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09110-01, weight 0.0) never becomes relevant, because no accumulation of separate intervals is needed when a single run already meets the minimum.

The amount charged reconciles exactly and carries no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): SGD 4.00 is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), which is precisely what the resolution rule produces for this trip. There is no fare defect to discount the charge on.

Nothing on this record is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08: the arrival event at 06:50:20 falls on the trace's 10-second cadence with no skew, the trace has zero gaps and 34 fixes across the waiting window against a 6-fix floor, the chat log's 4 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count with no missing msg_id and no five-minute gap across the arrival marker, and the fare reconciles. The single MISSING artifact is the traffic advisory, which carries weight 0.0, can carry no fact, and is relied on by no claim on either side.

The driver should be paid, not merely spared a refund. POL-NS-07 fixes his compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, that is SGD 3.20, and the anti-farming check does not withhold it: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the check requires, and the same figure over 120 completed trips in 30 days is a rate of 0.0083, far below the 0.08 threshold. The further condition that both limbs must trip for withholding is therefore not met, and the fee disposition is NO_ACTION while the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is not the trailing-30-day field this check reads.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling is addressed to both of you. The trip facts themselves line up behind the driver, but the case must go to a human reviewer, and that replaces any money outcome.

What the instruments show. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-09110, weight 1.00) places the driver's vehicle about 24 m from the Blk 612 Bedok Reservoir Rd lobby pin, stationary (0.0 km/h), for one continuous 330-second run from 06:50:00 to 06:55:30. The trip record (EV-TRIP-09110) records the driver's 'arrived' event at 06:50:20 and termination by the driver at 06:55:30 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event. On those facts all four limbs of POL-NS-01 are satisfied: there was an arrival event; the trace puts the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at or before it; the dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (330 s) exceeds the 300 s STANDARD minimum by 30 seconds; and the trip was terminated by the driver after the dwell elapsed under a recognised reason code. The SGD 4.00 charged in EV-FARE-09110 is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so it reconciles and carries no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

No rider-exonerating clause displaces it. POL-NS-04 fails because the driver replied ('Okay, waiting.' at 06:52:00, 20 seconds after the rider's 06:51:40 message, well inside the 120-second window) and because the rider track shows no qualifying in-radius fix (all 16 fixes about 519 m out). POL-NS-05 does not bite: at the arrival marker the driver was stationary and 24 m from the pin, neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or more. POL-NS-06 does not bite: the dwell met the minimum, so there is no shortfall to refund. On this record the fee would stand and the driver would receive SGD 3.20 under POL-NS-07 (80% of SGD 4.00), the anti-farming check not withholding it (no_show_terminations_30d is 1, a rate of about 0.008 against a threshold of 4 terminations and 0.08).

Why the case escalates anyway. POL-NS-09(c) makes escalation mandatory where the two profiles together show 2 or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days. EV-RPROF-09110 and EV-DPROF-09110 each record disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 2, and the filing itself describes this as another dispute with the same driver. That trigger does not depend on who is right about the fee, and no clause resolves it. Escalation is terminal: I issue no monetary ruling, no refund goes to the rider and no compensation goes to the driver, and the disputed SGD 4.00 is placed on hold — it is neither collected from the rider nor refunded — until the reviewer decides. The fare ledger shows the fee is still PENDING and nothing has been taken, so holding it is the correct interim state.

On the rider's profile: the rider-side abuse limb does not fire (no_show_disputes_30d is 0), and the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is not the field that limb reads. This escalation rests solely on the pair's repeat-dispute history, not on any imputation against either party.

Open question for the reviewer: whether the two parties' 90-day dispute history is a genuine pattern requiring intervention, and how the cancellation fee and any driver payment should be settled in light of it.

Finally, both sides cited the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09110-01, which is MISSING, carries weight 0.00 and fired MISSING_ARTIFACT. It carries no fact and nothing in this outcome turns on it: no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals was needed, because a single run already met the minimum.
